interface.longDescription: Plan creative work across image, video, sound and text. Build original campaign ideas, flowing short-form shot sequences, storyboards, realistic reference sheets, exact-copy graphics, generator prompts, audio plans and production handoffs. Choose quick concise directions or develop a project step by step with targeted public research. Execution uses only tools and external providers the user has available and chooses. Develop brand strategy, logo systems and logo/identity guides with explicit acceptance and file status. Includes integrated workflow contracts, reference and asset management, character and camera planning, copy review, captions, editing and coded-video routes, bounded QA and portable project recovery. Choose optional learning mode for a personal curriculum, short lessons, independent exercises and feedback across the existing creative domains; switch to creation when you need a finished result.
defaultPrompt: Tryb szybki: daj krótkie pomysły na grafikę, rolkę, tekst lub dźwięk.
Tryb rozbudowany: opracuj ze mną krok po kroku obraz, wideo, audio i montaż.
